fusions.name: Eight Rehearsed Strokes
fusions.desc: Lashes out with all 8 arms at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lid Trick
fusions.desc: Works an arm tip into the guard of the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: A Mind per Limb
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on 2 of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Second Stroke
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
